findings.summary: The benchmark "Catch" column uses "contamination" without ever saying what it means.
findings.evidence: Benchmark | cheap, reproducible, comparable | contamination; may not match your task
findings.fix: Define it in the table cell, e.g. "contamination (test questions leaked into training data, so scores overstate ability)".

findings.summary: The benchmark-saturation bullets sit under 'Three Ways to Score' as loose bullets, so a skimmer cannot tell they belong to the Benchmark row.
findings.evidence: Classic MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K are saturated at ~90%+ / MMLU-Pro, GPQA Diamond are nearing saturation too / Separate current models with Humanity's Last Exam, SWE-bench Pro
findings.fix: Move these into a small table (Tier | Benchmarks | Status) under a 'Benchmark saturation' subheading, or fold them into the Benchmark row's Catch cell.

findings.summary: 'Cohen's kappa' is named with no one-line idea behind it, so a learner cannot tell what it measures or how to read the value.
findings.fix: Add a one-line definition, for example 'Cohen's kappa = agreement between annotators corrected for chance; closer to 1 is better'.

findings.summary: The levers table mixes a UX lever with cost levers, and the table never says which metric (latency or cost) each lever reduces.
findings.fix: Add a column 'Reduces' (cost / latency / perceived latency), or move Streaming to the latency section.

findings.summary: The guardrails table mixes pipeline stages with a rule about downstream sinks, and the rule is repeated under Mistakes.
findings.evidence: Before shell, SQL, HTML | treat output as untrusted (injection risk) / Model output passed raw to a shell, SQL or HTML
findings.fix: Change the row's first cell to 'Output → sinks' or drop the row from the table. Keep the point once, either in the table or under Mistakes.

findings.summary: The cheat sheet uses an abbreviation and a term form that the chapter never introduced, so the same thing is named inconsistently.
findings.evidence: Benchmark (HLE, SWE-bench Pro) / Calibrated LLM-judge (page 3 says 'LLM-as-judge' and spells out 'Humanity's Last Exam')
findings.fix: Use 'LLM-as-judge' throughout and either spell out 'Humanity's Last Exam (HLE)' on page 3 or write it out in full on page 6.
